study: Full upstream talk-normal comparison; user-authorized follow-up, not the original selection holdout

upstream.adaptation: none; full original bytes as the sole system prompt

generator.temperature: provider default; CLI has no temperature option

judge.limitation: Same family/provider; separate blinded requests, not independent human evaluation

cases: All 12 unchanged parent cases; 6 long and 6 short. Original split labels retained in the source. This execution calls their union benchmark.
comparison: Fresh contemporaneous baseline, interleaved with upstream. Do not pool with earlier baseline or rescore earlier outcomes.
scoring: Identical parent judge and per-case required/critical criteria. Describe omissions, critical findings, style, clarity, lengths, usage, and timings separately. Word reduction is not a quality score.
boundaries: Requested analogy h5, correction d5/h2, uncertainty h6, and complete long explanations are evaluated under the user's task requirements, not upstream stylistic compliance.
integrity: Freeze inputs before generation. No quality-based retries, hidden thinking, tools, inherited conversations, or live instruction changes. Preserve failed attempts.
selection: Fixed comparison, no candidate tuning or conditional selection. No automatic adoption. Former holdout cases become observed in this distinct follow-up.
audit: Review all flagged answers and boundary-task responses. Publish model judgments and implementing-assistant interpretation separately.
